answer: Resist Sybils with blind task assignment: each identity receives randomly assigned, non-transferable jobs it cannot choose, like a voyage whose route is drawn by lottery. Influence grows only from completing assigned tasks well, judged through a prism of independent graders who see results, not identities. A farm cannot steer fakes toward easy rewards or copy one success across them, because each fake faces different work; thousands of fakes cost real, varied effort per identity, not one ivory shortcut.
